name: Bogura
shortDescription: Bogura is one of the most historically significant and culturally rich districts of Bangladesh, known for its ancient heritage, traditional culture, educational institutions, and famous Bogura Doi.

introduction.title: About Bogura
introduction.description: Located in the Rajshahi Division of northern Bangladesh, Bogura is a district rich in history, heritage, culture, and tradition. The district is widely known for Mahasthangarh, one of the oldest archaeological sites in Bangladesh, as well as its famous traditional sweet yogurt, known as Bogura Doi.

history.title: History of Bogura
history.description: Bogura has a long and important history that dates back thousands of years. The region is closely connected with Mahasthangarh, an ancient archaeological site that represents the rich historical heritage of Bangladesh. Over time, Bogura has developed into an important center for education, agriculture, business, and culture.

geography.title: Geography & Location
geography.description: Bogura is located in northern Bangladesh and is part of the Rajshahi Division. The district has a diverse geographical landscape and is connected with several important roads and neighboring districts.

culture.title: Culture & Heritage
culture.description: Bogura has a vibrant cultural identity shaped by its long history, local traditions, festivals, food, arts, and archaeological heritage. The district represents a unique combination of ancient history and modern development.

famousFood.title: Famous Food
famousFood.name: Bogura Doi
famousFood.description: Bogura Doi is one of the most famous traditional foods of Bangladesh. It is known for its unique taste, creamy texture, and long-standing cultural connection with the district.

upazilas.name: Adamdighi
upazilas.shortDescription: Adamdighi is an important upazila of Bogura, known for its agricultural activities, local communities, and growing educational institutions.

upazilas.name: Bogura Sadar
upazilas.shortDescription: Bogura Sadar is the administrative and commercial center of the district, known for its educational institutions, business activities, healthcare facilities, and urban development.

upazilas.name: Dhunat
upazilas.shortDescription: Dhunat is a northern upazila of Bogura, known for its agricultural landscape, rural heritage, local markets, and communities connected to the Jamuna river region.

upazilas.name: Dhupchanchia
upazilas.shortDescription: Dhupchanchia is an important upazila known for agriculture, trade, educational institutions, and its active local communities.

upazilas.name: Gabtali
upazilas.shortDescription: Gabtali is a well-known upazila of Bogura with a strong agricultural economy, busy local markets, and a rich rural cultural environment.

upazilas.name: Kahaloo
upazilas.shortDescription: Kahaloo is an agricultural upazila of Bogura known for its rural lifestyle, farming activities, local markets, and educational institutions.

upazilas.name: Nandigram
upazilas.shortDescription: Nandigram is a developing upazila of Bogura known for agriculture, traditional rural communities, local commerce, and educational activities.

upazilas.name: Sariakandi
upazilas.shortDescription: Sariakandi is a riverside upazila located near the Jamuna River, known for its agricultural production, river-based lifestyle, and scenic rural environment.

upazilas.name: Shajahanpur
upazilas.shortDescription: Shajahanpur is a rapidly developing upazila located close to Bogura town, known for residential growth, education, commerce, and agricultural activities.

upazilas.name: Sherpur
upazilas.shortDescription: Sherpur is an important commercial and agricultural upazila of Bogura, known for its busy markets, transportation connections, and local industries.

upazilas.name: Shibganj
upazilas.shortDescription: Shibganj is one of the historically important upazilas of Bogura and is widely known for Mahasthangarh, one of the oldest archaeological sites in Bangladesh.

upazilas.name: Sonatala
upazilas.shortDescription: Sonatala is an agricultural upazila of Bogura known for its rural communities, farming activities, local traditions, and educational institutions.

highlights.title: Historical Heritage
highlights.description: Home to Mahasthangarh, one of the most important archaeological sites in Bangladesh.

highlights.title: Educational Growth
highlights.description: Bogura has a large number of schools, colleges, madrasas, and other educational institutions.

highlights.title: Traditional Food
highlights.description: The district is internationally recognized for its famous Bogura Doi.

highlights.title: Tourist Attractions
highlights.description: Bogura offers a variety of historical, cultural, and natural places to explore.
